title: Waste Connections Announces Pricing of $600 Million of Senior Notes
summary: Following the previous announcement of the launch of a senior notes offering, Waste Connections, Inc. (TSX/NYSE: WCN) (Waste Connections or the Company) announced today that it has priced an underwritten public offering (the Offering) of $600 million aggregate principal amount of its 4.800% Senior Notes due 2036 (the Notes) at a price to the public of 99.732% of their face value. The Offering is expected to close on March 16, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. Net proceeds to Waste Connections from the Offering are expected to be approximately $593 million, after deducting underwriting fees and estimated Offering expenses, and are expected to be used, together with cash on hand, to repay a portion of the borrowings outstanding under its revolving credit facility.
